title: The e-side source lift under ambient projection
statement: Let A be finite commutative and d1,d2 supplied interchange diagrams for f:X→Y and g:Y→Z. Use the selected side n, the ambient data and sourceTransport of [def-pur-etale-graph-product-ambient-geometry]. Write af for the f-side ambientLambda, qG:G.U→Y for the middle support projection and cG:R(id_Y)→R(G.a) RqG for the inverse proper compositor for G.a qG=id_Y. Then normalization of the identity proper image on the selected source word followed by sourceTransport equals af whiskered by R(id_Y), then cG whiskered by F.functor, then liftInterchange whiskered by RqG (with the explicit associator). This concerns only the e-side square and B: no supplied k-square or Q exchange is present.

proof.text: Specialize the Cartesian-normalization and vertical-pasting clauses of the fixed chosen normalized exchange family to B above the e-side square. Transport along BW qH=qF and BV qN=prF, obtaining the outer Cartesian f-side exchange. This is exchange_vertical in Lean.

proof.text: For an arbitrary source complex, precompose the outer exchange by the inverse graph compositor. Cancel the B exchange with its inverse. Naturality of the e-side exchange moves the zF BW=zH compositor past it; inverse associativity for zF,BW,qH then gives source_core. Reuse comp_assoc and comp_assoc_inv proved in the Cartesian ambient-transport composition module; only their general proper direct-image coherence is used.

source.place: Tag 0F7C (vertical proper/open pasting); Tag 0F7J, final A--F comparison, with functorial direct-image associativity and its unit law.

proof.text: At an arbitrary complex on F.P, apply proper compositor associativity to F.p,G.a,qG, to BV,R,qG, and to BV,qN,r. The equations G.a qG=id, BV R=F.p G.a, R qG=qN r, BV qN=prF and prF r=F.p identify the composite maps. Cancel the intermediate compositors and use the proved direct_image_right_unit helper from OpenExchangeTower to identify the identity compositor with rightDerivedLowerStarIdIso. This gives proper_tail, a calculation involving no open exchange.

source.place: Tag 0F7C (vertical proper/open pasting); Tag 0F7J, final A--F comparison, with functorial direct-image associativity and its unit law.

proof.text: Combine proper_tail and source_core. Naturality first moves the identity direct-image comparison through the source Cartesian transport, then moves the terminal exchange and graph compositor through the two proper terminal compositors. Functoriality groups the result into source_core. Instantiate this general source_grid calculation for First and Second; expand the specified words and use extensionality of natural transformations and isomorphisms. No k-square, Q exchange or open-composition law is used.

theorem etaleGraphAmbientSourcePasting
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (d₁ d₂ : EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram f g) (second : Bool) :
    (match second with
    | false =>
      let af := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.ambientLambda
        d₁.sourcePresentation d₂.sourcePresentation false A
      let qg := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.q
        (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₁.compactification)
        (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₂.compactification) false
      let cg := (rightDerivedLowerStarCompOfEq (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.First.G d₁ d₂).a qg (𝟙 Y)
        (EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.z_q
          (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₁.compactification)
          (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₂.compactification) false)).symm
      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (d₁.sourcePresentation.functor A)
          (rightDerivedLowerStarIdIso A Y) ≪≫
        Functor.rightUnitor _ ≪≫
        EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.First.sourceTransport d₁ d₂ A) =
      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight af R((𝟙 Y)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ cg ≪≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.First.liftInterchange d₁ d₂ A)
          R((qg)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]))
    | true =>
      let af := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.ambientLambda
        d₁.sourcePresentation d₂.sourcePresentation true A
      let qg := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.q
        (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₁.compactification)
        (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₂.compactification) true
      let cg := (rightDerivedLowerStarCompOfEq (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.Second.G d₁ d₂).a qg (𝟙 Y)
        (EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.z_q
          (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₁.compactification)
          (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₂.compactification) true)).symm
      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (d₂.sourcePresentation.functor A)
          (rightDerivedLowerStarIdIso A Y) ≪≫
        Functor.rightUnitor _ ≪≫
        EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.Second.sourceTransport d₁ d₂ A) =
      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight af R((𝟙 Y)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ cg ≪≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.Second.liftInterchange d₁ d₂ A)
          R((qg)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])))
